newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Hyundai's Citizens stake purchase approved.
newsitem.headline: Hyundai's Citizens stake purchase approved.

text.p: The Korea Securities and Exchange Commission approved the purchase by Hyundai Group's units of a combined 44.52 percent stake of Citizens Investment Trust Management and Securities Co Ltd, a commission statement said on Tuesday.
Hyundai Group, South Korea's top conglomerate in terms of assets, will become the largest shareholder of Citizens Investment.
Hyundai Electronics will hold a 34.52 percent stake in Citizens Investment's paid-in capital of 370 billion won. Hyundai Securities will hold the remaining 10 percent.

Citizens Investment, a major domestic institutional investor formerly called Citizens Investment Trust Management Co, earlier this month expanded its business into securities and merchant banking areas. It earlier concentrated on trust business.
The statement said Hyundai Electronics would pay a total of 114.23 billion won to buy the 34.52 percent stake in Citizen Investment. Hyundai Securities had already acquired the 10 percent stake.
"It's too early to say Hyundai will run our company. The decision will be made in a shareholders meeting on April 15," said a Citizen Investment spokesman. "But it is highly probable."
